blocks.text: With Alepo **mobile recharge software**, marketing creates prepaid plans, scratch-card and digital top-ups and recharge bonuses in one place. Each one reaches charging, policy, AAA and every sales channel at once.

sections.h2: Vouchers tracked until they are used

blocks.text: Every voucher is tracked through the full recharge voucher lifecycle, including recalled, stolen and damaged cards.
Your team blocks a card that should not be used before it is redeemed.
Customers top up through self-care, CRM, IVR, USSD and partners. Dealers top up customers electronically from Mobile POS, with no printed card.

items.a: **Mobile recharge software** manages how prepaid subscribers add credit or buy plans, through vouchers, digital top-ups, dealers and self-service channels.
